title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind - il vento d'oro (Star-mix)
description:
Did a short star-mix of il vento d'oro from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind. Look, I already did Steel Ball Run's theme, so I had to do Golden Wind's theme too!!

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Lead is @1 (Default Version)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Lead is @7 (Funny Version)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Skips the Intro (INTRO Skipped)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Enables the Intro (INTRO Enabled)
